mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.execute.tool: Run a TypeScript probe program against the bound factory controller. Prefer the inline `code` form: it is precompiled as a virtual .ts file in the appliedscripts root, so relative JSON imports and require_recipes() work without creating files. Use `file` for long or reusable scripts. Returns logs, result and reason.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.execute.file: Appliedscripts-relative .ts file to run. Takes precedence over `code`.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.execute.code: Inline TypeScript probe; treated as a virtual .ts file in the appliedscripts root.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.execute.timeou: Maximum ticks to wait (0 = evaluate only, -1 = no caller timeout).
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.upload.tool: Compile and replace the controller's production program from a workspace file. The existing program is untouched if compilation fails.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.upload.file: Appliedscripts-relative .ts file to compile and upload. Required so the production program keeps a local backup.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.status.tool: Read-only MCP status: connection, MCP server port, bound controller coordinates and its current script file, the appliedscripts workspace path, and whether auto-reload is on.
